package.description: Remote input for Xbox consoles, use any controller with your Xbox.

en-US.description: Remote input for Xbox consoles, use any controller with your Xbox.
en-US.longDescription:
Remote input for Xbox consoles, use any controller with your Xbox.

The server version of the app is intended for PC installation, so that controllers connected to the PC, can have their inputs be forwarded to the corresponding client app running on a post-2012 Xbox-branded console.
en-US.name: Oberon Remote
